assumptions.message: Created a Profile entity linked 1:1 to members to support avatar, bio, follower count, and following count as described in the requirement.
Set hot pink (#ff1493) and dark background (#121212) based on the requirement visual brief.
Configured two separate application areas for Member (browsing, posting, interacting) and Moderator (back-office report queue and content hiding).
Visibility policy hides content marked HIDDEN from regular members and public feeds.

Design direction: Forum / Discussion Board (Feed + Thread View); palette Dark neutral + topic accent colors + unread indicator + reputation badge; fonts Accessibility First (Atkinson Hyperlegible / Atkinson Hyperlegible); from ui-ux-pro-max@28b3b8dee8c9
